{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
if data['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any():
    data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
else:
    data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].astype(float)

# Exclude refunded orders and QA test orders (revenue == '999999.99')
completed_only = data[data['status'] == 'completed']
qa_count = (completed_only['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum()
if qa_count > 0:
    completed_only = completed_only[completed_only['revenue'] != '999999.99']

# Compute average revenue per channel, stratified by customer_segment
stratified_avg = completed_only.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue_clean'].mean().unstack(level='channel')

# Compute difference: email - paid_search within each segment
stratified_diff = stratified_avg['email'] - stratified_avg['paid_search']

# Now extract and print only the numbers we need for evidence
print("Average revenue for email in 'loyal' segment:", stratified_avg.loc['loyal', 'email'])
print("Average revenue for paid_search in 'loyal' segment:", stratified_avg.loc['loyal', 'paid_search'])
print("Average revenue for email in 'new' segment:", stratified_avg.loc['new', 'email'])
print("Average revenue for paid_search in 'new' segment:", stratified_avg.loc['new', 'paid_search'])
print("Average revenue for email in 'returning' segment:", stratified_avg.loc['returning', 'email'])
print("Average revenue for paid_search in 'returning' segment:", stratified_avg.loc['returning', 'paid_search'])
print("Difference (email - paid_search) in 'loyal' segment:", stratified_diff.loc['loyal'])
print("Difference (email - paid_search) in 'new' segment:", stratified_diff.loc['new'])
print("Difference (email - paid_search) in 'returning' segment:", stratified_diff.loc['returning'])"}
